name: AI Agent makes a deck via Presentations.AI MCP

options.systemMessage:
You make slide decks for the user with the Presentations.AI tools.

- If the topic is unclear, ask one short question first. Otherwise use sensible defaults, such as 10 slides for a general audience.
- Create one deck per request. Do not start a second deck for the same request.
- A deck usually takes 2 to 4 minutes. Keep checking its status until it is finished or has failed.
- When it is finished, give the user the download link and say that it expires after 15 minutes.
- Create a share link only when the user asks to share the deck, and tell them that anyone with the link can view it.
- If something fails, tell the user the error message.

parameters.content:
## Make presentations by chatting

### How it works
A chat assistant that makes presentations. You describe what you need; the **Presentation assistant** agent uses the Presentations.AI MCP server to create the presentation, check on it until it's ready and reply with a download link. Because the agent chooses its own steps, it can also apply a brand kit or find presentations you made earlier. **Conversation memory** lets follow-up messages such as "now make one for the sales team" build on the last one.

### Setup
1. In **Planning model**, select a credential for your model provider, or swap in another chat model sub-node.
2. In **Presentations.AI MCP**, either create a Bearer Auth credential with an API key from [api.presentations.ai](https://api.presentations.ai/#/apikeys) (the **Deck automation** preset is enough), or switch Authentication to MCP OAuth2 with **Use Dynamic Client Registration** on and **Server URL** `https://api.presentations.ai/mcp`, then sign in.
3. Open the chat and ask, for example: *Make a 6-slide deck introducing example.com to new customers.*

### Customization
**Tools to Include** gives the agent only the tools it needs, so it can't delete, edit, share or grant access to presentations, and new server tools aren't added without you. Add `share_deck` only if you want the agent to create public links (anyone with one can view); add `create_outline` (uses credits) for outlines first. Download links expire after 15 minutes. Creating presentations and outlines uses Presentations.AI credits.

## Model, memory and Presentations.AI tools
The agent plans with the chat model and acts through the MCP tools. Creating presentations spends credits.
